verdicts.rationale: The flagged divergence is the on-E Grin-Malkin Hat explosion — an AoE Pyro DMG instance. Damage numbers/math are constitution-excluded, and a damage-proc is an off-limits render surface (cannot implement). The skill carries effects: [], so there is no buff/heal/shred bar for the timeline to diverge from. The only other omission is a self-heal that scales with Prop Surplus stacks: self-only sustain on an on-field DPS, gated on an untracked resource, so it neither passes the purpose test (a Lyney player is not misled about rotation choices) nor authors cleanly to a fixed value. No note warranted.

groundedIn.claim: The on-E Hat explosion is a damage instance, not modeled in effects.
groundedIn.quote: If a Grin-Malkin Hat is on field when E is cast, the Hat explodes (skillExplode) dealing AoE Charged Attack DMG equal to a Pyrotechnic Strike. Not modeled in effects.

groundedIn.claim: The explosion is AoE Pyro DMG (damage-only, constitution-excluded).
groundedIn.quote: the fireworks will cause it to explode, dealing AoE Pyro DMG equal to that of a Pyrotechnic Strike.

groundedIn.claim: The other unmodeled piece is a self-heal that scales with Prop Surplus stacks.
groundedIn.quote: Skill consumes all Prop Surplus stacks; DMG and HP-restore both scale with stacks cleared. No effect skeletons for the stacking-damage bonus or heal — reviewer to author.

groundedIn.claim: The heal targets Lyney himself (self sustain).
groundedIn.quote: this will also regenerate Lyney's HP based on his Max HP.
